exposure: presence of oropharyngeal clot at presentation
cohort: The study included 826 presentations of secondary post-tonsillectomy bleeds in patients under 16 years of age without known blood dyscrasias, who presented to Perth Children's Hospital between February 2018 and February 2022.
finding: Patients presenting with a secondary post-tonsillectomy bleed have a low risk of rebleeding while under observation, with those having a normal oropharyngeal examination at presentation showing a very low risk of rebleed.
